assumptions.choice: Session VWAP is calculated using Typical Price (High + Low + Close) / 3 multiplied by volume, resetting cumulative sums at the first bar of each calendar date.
assumptions.reason: Standard definition of daily intraday VWAP.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss is checked in next() against bar Low (for long) or High (for short) relative to position average entry price (self.position.price), issuing self.close() when triggered.
assumptions.reason: Ensures clean single-order tracking with Backtrader pending order semantics while respecting exact stop thresholds.

assumptions.choice: When an exit signal (opposite entry condition) occurs while a position is open, self.close() is called to exit. Re-entry in the opposite direction is evaluated on subsequent bars after position closure.
assumptions.reason: Adheres to entry rule requirement of no open position and canonical rule against multi-order state transitions in single iteration.
